findings.summary: ARQ-136 sketches t: Flicks in a gafira-doc trait, but 02 2.1/2.2 and the V5 table forbid gafira-doc -> gafira-time, so the row is unimplementable; the instant became a type parameter. The rule (time apart, not in the context) holds. The row must be reconciled.
No test pins ARQ-136's 'the instant is not in the context' rule, the rule the delivery deviated on: adding a t field to MeasureCx would fail no test in the repo.
720 authored code lines against a forecast of 430 (x1.4 = 600), over the ~700 ceiling that needs the owner's explicit OK; no OK is recorded.
